articles.headline: Why retail companies are taking products off shelves
articles.summary: From Dollar General to Under Armour, retailers are culling assortments to get back to healthy growth, or at least, stabilize their business. For brands, excess inventory hurts profitability if it has to be discounted. For box stores, it’s more of a defensive play that allows for better curation.
